rows: Prove that the five Decad syzygies (or five *Marsanes* consonantal positions) and seven Sefer doubles (or seven vowels) participate in the same relationship. These are currently different objects being identified by their counts.
Establish the actual rule that changes counting units at the threshold. Our selective quotient produces 71 and 72, but we chose its behavior to produce those results.
Identify which of W72's 36 binary fibers is the exceptional one, using independently fixed musical, genealogical, or symbolic relationships.
Demonstrate that one assignment preserves the Completed Harmony, TOL, Sefer, Shem, and source-native relationships better than the alternatives—without fitting it to known anomalies.
